work: PP-SPEC-081 Reproof: The Umpire Assay Protocol

human_authors.name: Craig Thomas Ellrod
human_authors.role: Author and inventor; originated reproof (independent re-execution of a proof) and directed the research that produced this specification; reproducibility requirement (Prior Art Declaration 4a); every normative decision, review and acceptance

ai_systems.role: Research assistance at the author's direction: gap analysis of PP-SPEC-077 to 079, drafting, structuring, naming proposals, schema

conception_and_normative_decisions.note: The author originated reproof and asked whether Proof Protocol specified it; the AI's gap analysis answered that question at his direction. Procedural details the AI proposed are adopted only on the author's acceptance.

design_and_naming.note: Claude proposed: Umpire Assay Protocol name and mining terms (Head, Check, Umpire Assay, Split, Splitting Limit); Instance and Class Reproof; Cells and Insufficient; Reproof Status values; IP-R1 to IP-R4; UAP-1 tag

method.notes: Shares drafted by the AI from its record of what it proposed and what the author directed, for the author to confirm or correct before release. MAY be re-measured with a tool such as ProofJack.com.
